data.one_liner: Open Source Routing Machine (OSRM) client for Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides an interface to communicate with an OSRM server to retrieve routing, nearest location, and match information.
use_when: You need to integrate OSRM routing and directions into a Dart or Flutter application
You want to query nearest services or match GPS traces using an OSRM backend
avoid_when: You need an all-in-one embedded mapping widget rather than a backend routing client
Table, trip, or tile services are required, as they are not yet fully implemented
strengths: Simple and easy-to-use interface for OSRM APIs
Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux
weaknesses: Certain OSRM services such as Table, Trip, and Tile are still pending
data.setup_notes: Simply add osrm to your pubspec.yaml dependencies and instantiate the OSRM class.
